name: @tjalve/qube
description: QUBE composer CLI for coordinating the standalone planning, execution, quality, and continuation tools.
author: tjalve

scripts.build:deps: pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-core run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/aib run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-claude-code run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/qube-adapter-grok-build run build && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/aie run build:deps && pnpm --dir ../.. --filter @tjalve/aie run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.pack:check: pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run build && pnpm pack --dry-run --json && node ../../scripts/restore-publish-dependencies.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run pack:check && node ../../scripts/check-strict-package-json.mjs
